verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Omarchy ships nineteen built-in themes. You can pick one via Style > Theme in the Omarchy Menu or jump straight to the theme selector with a hotkey. A chosen theme restyles the whole system at once (terminal, bar, notifications, wallpaper), and theme matching extends to several editors. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the switching, and explicit confirmation that a switch applies instantly.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can instantly switch between multiple built-in visual themes that restyle the whole desktop

citations.quote: Omarchy comes with nineteen beautiful themes. You can select between them via Style > Theme in the Omarchy Menu
A theme restyles the whole system at once: terminal, bar, notifications, wallpaper.
hop directly to the theme selector using `Super + Ctrl + Shift + Space`.
Theme matching is offered for `VSCode`, `Cursor`, `VSCodium`, `Helix`, and `Zed`.
